topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I carefully opened the door to find a package sitting on my doorstep, wrapped neatly and addressed to someone I didn't recognize. It dawned on me that this must have been intended for the previous tenant. I took a moment to think about what the right course of action would be. After all, it's easy to toss aside something that isn't for you, but I felt a responsibility to ensure it reached the right hands. I decided to do a bit of detective work. I started by checking the name on the building's directory and then gave a quick call to the address listed. A few minutes later, I was able to forward the package to its rightful owner. It felt good knowing I had helped, even in such a small way.
